lines.text:
Oooh... So you want to challenge Erika, the
Gym Leader?\c
I’ll have you know, we only let Trainers with
[VAR COLOR(0006)]cute Pokémon[VAR COLOR(0000)] enter the Gym!\c
Do you have one? Here, let me see!

So, you haven’t given up on getting into
the Celadon City Gym, huh?\c
Well, do you have a [VAR COLOR(0006)]cute Pokémon[VAR COLOR(0000)] with you?
I’d better have a look to make sure!
No way you’re getting into the Gym if you don’t\nshow me a cute Pokémon!\c\nBye!

Huh? [VAR POKNAME(0004)]?!
...\c
It’s cute! SUPER cute!
Can...can I pet it? Just a bit? Pleeease?

Oh...
Oh!\c
Oh, it feels so good! I just want to bury my face
in its belly!\c
It smells good, too! I love it!
F-fine, then! I guess I have to let you into\nthe Celadon City Gym, seeing as you brought\r\na [VAR COLOR(0006)]cute Pokémon[VAR COLOR(0000)] and all.
